onboard1Title: See something wrong on a bus? Report it.
onboard1Text: Reckless driving, overcharging, harassment: tell us in two minutes, with photos and the exact place. No account needed.
onboard2Text: Every report gets a receipt ID. Watch it move from received to resolved, and get a notification at each step.
